posts.title: Building the Crown of Thorns
posts.excerpt: How Marko Tervonen's signature MT-COT came together — from the gradient white finish to the hand-painted artwork.
posts.body:
When Marko reached out about a signature build, I knew it had to feel like **The Crown**, not just look like it.

We started from the 8141 P Classic platform and reworked the finish into a gradient that fades from transparent white across the body to near-black at the headstock. The *Crown of Thorns* artwork is painted by hand — no decals, no shortcuts.

## The details that matter

- Ebony fingerboard with a compound 12"–16" radius
- EMG 81 into an Evertune bridge for rock-solid tuning
- A dual-LED battery indicator built right into the volume knob

This one took months. Worth every hour.

posts.title: Why I pick every piece of wood by hand
posts.excerpt: The wood decides half the sound. Here's why I never order tonewood from a photo.
posts.body:
People ask why I don't just order tonewood in bulk. Simple: **the wood decides half the sound.**

Every top I use for a transparent finish gets chosen in person. I'm looking at grain, weight, stiffness and how it rings when I tap it. Two boards from the same tree can behave completely differently.

That's the whole point of a handbuilt guitar. It isn't a product off a shelf — it's this piece of wood, for this player.

Today is a great day to play guitar.
